title: A strict margin tolerates bounded local errors
statement: If actual switching fields have errors |e_i|<=epsilon_i<h_i, the same nominal energy decreases by more than2w_i(h_i-epsilon_i). Row-sum/offset uncertainty may enter that budget. At fixed s, formal drive work dW=-sum w_i s_i dH closes model work against flip release. Thermal activation with unbounded tails, arbitrary spontaneous flips, actual mechanical work calibration and efficiency remain outside this contract.
